parameters.query: =SELECT id, equity::float8 AS equity, peakequity::float8 AS "peakEquity", inposition AS "inPosition", symbol, entryprice::float8 AS "entryPrice", stopprice::float8 AS "stopPrice", firsttarget::float8 AS "firstTarget", notionalfull::float8 AS "notionalFull", notionalremaining::float8 AS "notionalRemaining", halfclosed AS "halfClosed", trailstop::float8 AS "trailStop", highestsinceentry::float8 AS "highestSinceEntry", barsopen AS "barsOpen", tradinglocked AS "tradingLocked" FROM paper_state ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

=UPDATE paper_state SET equity = {{ $json.equity }}, peakequity = {{ $json.peakEquity }}, inposition = {{ $json.inPosition }}, symbol = '{{ $json.symbol }}', entryprice = {{ $json.entryPrice }}, stopprice = {{ $json.stopPrice }}, firsttarget = {{ $json.firstTarget }}, notionalfull = {{ $json.notionalFull }}, notionalremaining = {{ $json.notionalRemaining }}, halfclosed = {{ $json.halfClosed }}, trailstop = {{ $json.trailStop }}, highestsinceentry = {{ $json.highestSinceEntry }}, barsopen = {{ $json.barsOpen }}, tradinglocked = {{ $json.tradingLocked }}, lastupdated = '{{ $json.lastUpdated }}' WHERE id = {{ $json.id }} RETURNING id

=INSERT INTO paper_trades (closedat, symbol, reason, entryprice, exitprice, notional, grosspnl, fees, netpnl, equityafter) VALUES ('{{ $('Manage Exit').item.json.trade.closedAt }}', '{{ $('Manage Exit').item.json.trade.symbol }}', '{{ $('Manage Exit').item.json.trade.reason }}', {{ $('Manage Exit').item.json.trade.entryPrice }}, {{ $('Manage Exit').item.json.trade.exitPrice }}, {{ $('Manage Exit').item.json.trade.notional }}, {{ $('Manage Exit').item.json.trade.grossPnl }}, {{ $('Manage Exit').item.json.trade.fees }}, {{ $('Manage Exit').item.json.trade.netPnl }}, {{ $('Manage Exit').item.json.trade.equityAfter }}) RETURNING id

parameters.content:
## Paper Trading Engine (refined hybrid strategy)
Runs hourly. If a position is open, manages exit (stop / partial target / trailing stop / trend invalidation / max hold). If flat, scans approved symbols for a Section 7A pullback entry. All state lives in the paper_state and paper_trades Data Tables - no real BingX credentials are used anywhere in this workflow.
